name: Exterior Masonry Finish Coat 1
intent: Finish coat 1. Acrylic or elastomeric (elastomeric gets 1.50x coating system modifier). Spray+backroll, roll, or brush.
doctrine: Masonry finish coat 1. Acrylic rates shown. Elastomeric uses FAC_MSRY_COATING_SYSTEM (1.50x) — reduces spray_backroll to 150, roll to 100 SF/hr. Spray-only PROHIBITED — mandatory backroll on porous masonry. Substrate type modifier applies. No intercoat sanding.
